$comment: Operations for the Survivor sub-pool, checked in so a schedule or a parameter is a reviewed change. Read by scripts/ops (npm run ops). Crons are UTC, 5 fields. tickSchedule is the Survivor Sweep Routine (npm run ops -- hourly) and dailySchedule is the Survivor Daily Routine (npm run ops -- daily); both are here rather than only in docs/ROUTINES.md so changing one is a reviewed change. The scores job states its six slots in EASTERN TIME (scheduleEt, one expression per slot) and they are converted on every run: a fixed UTC cron for 3 AM ET would be an hour wrong for half the season. tickSchedule was widened from 9-23,0-2 to 7-23,0-3 on 2026-09-11 so those overnight slots are observed at all - under the old tick nine of the twelve slot-offsets fell in the gap between two ticks and would never have run. reminderLeadHours is no longer read at run time - it is the minimum-notice floor the pick-reminder cron is tested against. Only pick-reminder and chase may send, and only when the environment has REMINDER_AUTOSEND=true; every other job drafts or writes rows and never mails. pick-reminder fires the three morning slots Anthony set on 2026-09-10 - Wednesday, Thursday and Friday at 12:00 UTC, which is 8 AM ET in EDT and 7 AM in EST. reminderLeadHours is no longer what triggers a run: the slot a run belongs to is the ET calendar day (scripts/remind/lib/due.ts) and this cron is the minute the mail goes. It is the notice the two SAME-DAY slots owe - wed names that Wednesday's early deadline, fri names that Friday's late one - and tests/unit/ops.test.ts holds the cron to giving at least that many hours before a 2 PM ET deadline in both EDT and EST, so moving either one alone fails CI.

sweep.what: Unread mail from every owner and player_email address on a live entry, whatever its subject or label, plus mail from anyone else whose subject names the pool or the picks; picks recorded through admin_submit_pick, everything else staged for Anthony.

pick-reminder.what: The week reminder to every live address, on the morning of each of a week's three slots - Wednesday naming the early deadline, Thursday naming the late one, Friday the final call naming that same late one - once per slot (week:N:wed|thu|fri), exact recipient count.

chase.what: One message per recipient with no pick for the open week, once per recipient per lock day.

lynne-import.what: Her newest Football xlsx from Gmail into lynne_roster, once per sha256.

results.what: Her newest Football xlsx as the last locked week's results through admin_apply_lynne_import, once per sha256, variances reported never resolved.

scores.what: Finals from the free ESPN scoreboard onto nfl_games, matched on week and both teams; never creates a game, never overwrites one already final, and touches no other table. Six slots on the ET wall clock - Fri 3 AM, Sat 3 AM, Sun 5 PM, Sun 10 PM, Mon 3 AM, Tue 3 AM - overnight so nothing collides with the reminder jobs, and read against ET on every run so none of them drifts an hour when the clock changes on 2026-11-01.

distribute.what: After the Friday lock, one Bcc draft to every live address with the grid link and the standings sentence. A draft, never a send.
